target.powerAndOtherLoad: uncontrolled; /proc/loadavg is recorded before every launch

methodology.firstLaunch: trial 0 runs every artifact once immediately after its build; it is reported separately as first-launch-after-build, never as a controlled cold-cache start
methodology.ordering: every measured trial runs all adapter/mode pairs; the start offset rotates each trial and odd trials reverse the order
methodology.equivalence: every passed launch must report identical workload parameters, per-phase operation and native mutation counts, lifecycle ownership, retention and cleanup; calibrated initial/final native paint trees and renderer identity must match across all artifacts; otherwise the comparison is rejected
methodology.failures: failed launches are retained with logs and excluded from distributions; they are never retried
methodology.intervals: per-launch metrics use each fresh process as the independent unit (percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 244); pooled per-operation samples are described but not bootstrapped
methodology.rss: controller samples /proc statm of the launched process and its descendants (native host) every 20 ms; peaks can be missed and shared pages are counted per process
methodology.startup: controller spawn epoch combined with child performance.timeOrigin milestones; window open and view mount are acknowledged native states, not display presentation
methodology.aotVerification: controller inspects and hashes the exact executable it launches; child mode is only a declaration
methodology.developmentCalibration: BUN_JSC_useDFGJIT=0 for development calibration only, as in native CI (#287); timed launches keep default tiers
unsupported: direct Rust GPUI baseline (no equivalent Rust workload exists yet)
hardware GPU (this runner uses the session renderer, recorded per calibration)
